answer.book: Joh. Georgii Fueslini, Conclavia romana reserata, sive Mysterium iniquitatis in electione Pontificum Romanorum (Tiguri, 1691): a polemical treatise in eight dissertations, each with numbered sections, preceded by a dedication and a preface and followed by indexes of authors, scripture passages, and subjects, and a note to the reader.
